priceInr.description: Price in rupees, e.g. 2499. Set this to take payment when people register. Empty: registration is free (no payment).

priceEur.description: Price in euros for the French site, e.g. 35. Empty: no payment on the French site.

priceLabel.description: Optional text shown instead of the numbers above, e.g. From ₹2,499. Leave empty to show the price automatically.

menuTitle.description: Optional. The heading of the list below (the Menu list). Empty: the page says Menu, with a food icon. For a non-food workshop write something like The Experience Flow.

menuNumbered.description: Tick to show 1, 2, 3 beside each line of the list instead of dots. Wrap a lead-in in double asterisks to make it bold, e.g. **The Talk:** the rest of the line.

slots.description: Optional. Time slots offered on every date, e.g. 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM and 2:00 PM – 4:00 PM. People pick a date, then a slot.

passes.description: Optional. Ticket types, e.g. Single seat and Duo pass, each with its own price. When you add passes, they set the price (the priceInr and priceEur above are ignored).
